root_cause_label: Failure to Use Submission Tool for Task Completion
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent successfully implemented and verified a correct optimized SQL query in /app/sol.sql but failed to signal task completion properly, using 'echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT' instead of the required submission tool or protocol.
t_err_evidence: echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT — agent submits without verifying correctness against original query
t_commit_evidence: Step 23 is the only completion attempt; after this the trajectory ends with no further actions, locking in the failure.
t_surface_evidence: echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT — no confirmation original query matches; submission is final step
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked knowledge of the correct benchmark completion protocol and assumed that echoing a specific string would signal task completion, when the harness requires a different submission mechanism (e.g., a dedicated tool call or exit command).
